co2.title: Annual CO₂ emissions
co2.description: Annual total emissions of carbon dioxide (CO₂), excluding land-use change, measured in million tonnes.

co2_per_capita.title: CO₂ emissions per capita
co2_per_capita.description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions from burning fossil fuels and industrial processes. This includes emissions from transport, electricity generation, and heating, but not land-use change.
co2_per_capita.source: Global Carbon Budget (2025) [https://globalcarbonbudget.org/]; Population based on various sources (2024) [https://ourworldindata.org/population-sources]
